name: Monetrix USD
oneLiner: USDM is Monetrix's USDC-backed dollar token on HyperEVM; sUSDM staking adds yield through a separate wrapper.
collateral: USDC at mint, then deployed into Monetrix's on-chain Hyperliquid delta-neutral portfolio including spot assets, matching short perpetual positions, portfolio-margin slots, and vault or redeem-escrow USDC. Liquid USDM is the base dollar receipt; strategy yield accrues only via the separate sUSDM wrapper.
pegMechanism: USDM targets 1:1 USDC convertibility through Monetrix mint/redeem flows while backing is deployed into a delta-neutral Hyperliquid portfolio. The sUSDM staking wrapper accrues strategy yield separately and is not admitted as an active Pharos stablecoin until a maintained price and market-cap runtime source exists.

oracleRisk.summary: USDM is minted and redeemed 1:1 against USDC while Monetrix deploys backing into a delta-neutral Hyperliquid strategy; it has no user-owned collateral debt or token-level liquidation branch. The reviewed docs do not identify a public strategy price feed or failover path.

branchApplicability.rationale: Monetrix documents USDM minting by depositing USDC, redemption by burning USDM and claiming USDC after a configured cooldown, and a protocol-managed long-spot/short-perpetual delta-neutral strategy. The reviewed product does not expose borrower-specific collateral positions, collateral ratios, liquidation auctions, backstops, or shutdown branches for USDM; the remaining strategy valuation and operational feed details are retained as opaque rather than invented.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: USDM is backed by USDC, so blacklistability resolves through the upstream Circle collateral dependency rather than a separate Pharos override.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: USDM's declared reserve dependency is USDC. Pharos therefore treats the asset as inheriting upstream freeze and blacklist exposure from Circle's USDC collateral.

mintAuthority.summary: Users mint USDM 1:1 by depositing USDC into MonetrixVault. The token only accepts mint calls from that vault, while a reviewed 48-hour timelock holds the ACL upgrader role and can replace UUPS mint-critical implementations.

controls.label: MonetrixVault deposit and mint contract
controls.capDescription: User deposits are bounded by the live minimum, per-transaction maximum, and protocol TVL cap in MonetrixConfig.
controls.evidence: Monetrix documents MonetrixVault.deposit(amount) as the user mint path. At HyperEVM block 40308120, USDM vault() resolves to this reviewed contract.

controls.label: Monetrix 48-hour upgrade timelock
controls.evidence: At block 40308120, the Monetrix ACL reports this timelock holds UPGRADER and the timelock reports getMinDelay() = 172800 seconds. USDM's UUPS authorization checks that ACL role.

controls.label: Monetrix 24-hour governor timelock
controls.evidence: At block 40308120, the Monetrix ACL reports this timelock holds GOVERNOR and the timelock reports getMinDelay() = 86400 seconds.

review.evidence: Primary docs identify the user deposit path and deployed contracts. HyperEVM reads at block 40308120 confirm the USDM UUPS implementation, vault address, central ACL, the 24-hour GOVERNOR timelock, and the 48-hour UPGRADER timelock.

reserveReview.rationale: Monetrix documents USDM minting against USDC through MonetrixVault and separately describes deployment into a delta-neutral Hyperliquid strategy. The static envelope identifies the documented USDC input, but the public sources do not expose a dated, independently reconciled breakdown of strategy custody, margin, or redeemable balances; those exposures remain explicitly unknown rather than being split into invented slices.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Monetrix documented USDC mint input and strategy architecture
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current strategy positions, exchange custody, margin balances, and redemption liquidity are not independently published as a reconciled reserve snapshot.

notices.title: sUSDM watchlisted
notices.message: Monetrix's sUSDM wrapper has an official contract, but it currently lacks a DefiLlama stablecoin row, CoinGecko ID, or Pharos ERC-4626 NAV runtime adapter. Pharos tracks base USDM until sUSDM has a maintained price and market-cap source.
